# [TASK] Fix issue templates and the contract so the drift stops recurring

## Task
Fix the issue templates and the work contract so new issues start conformant, instead of needing the retrofit #246 and #247 had to do by hand.

## Scope
`.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` and the contract file. Existing issues are #246/#247.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `user-story.md` has a `## Parent Epic` section — its absence is why Stories had no parent link while Tasks did
- [x] Every template states the both-ways linking rule, including the native sub-issue link
- [x] Every template states that an issue must not be closed with an unchecked box, and that a superseded item is rescoped naming the ADR
- [x] Every template states concretely what may not go in Notes: build output, review-round narrative, test counts, coverage percentages
- [x] The contract carries the same two rules, since `gh issue create` does not apply templates
- [x] All four templates still parse, and an issue made from each passes the audit that found the original drift

## Estimate
**Hours:** 2

## Notes

Commits `10c2293` and `3eed52c`.

The root cause was that `user-story.md` had no `## Parent Epic` section — that is why 33 Stories had no parent while Tasks mostly did. All four templates now also carry the both-ways linking rule, the do-not-close-unchecked rule, and a concrete list of what may not go in Notes.

The same two rules went into the contract as well, because `gh issue create` does not apply templates — a template-only fix would have been inert for the autonomous runs. Verified by running the audit script that found the original drift against the templates themselves: all four pass.
